subject: Meteorology
title: Branches of Meteorology
description: Learn Branches of Meteorology in one minute.

hook.text: Meteorology isn't just forecasting—it branches into at least six specialized fields.

buildup.text: Synoptic meteorology studies large-scale weather patterns. Mesoscale focuses on regional storms and fronts.

discovery.text: Micrometeorology examines conditions near the ground—critical for agriculture and air quality.

twist.text: Planetary meteorology studies weather on Mars, Jupiter, and Venus—yes, Mars has dust storms spanning the planet.

climax.text: Aviation, marine, and broadcast meteorology each apply the science to specific human needs.

punchline.text: Every scale of the atmosphere has its own specialty.
